text: 1361 prints resp.text when an upload response is not OK before returning resp.json; 1366 only removes a trailing space from that added line. Accepted script retains body printing and the existing three-attempt retry/idempotency logic. This is a scoped diagnostic change, not a retry-policy repair or proof that non-JSON failures are handled: resp.json can still fail and the uploader was not executed. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: ATN upload failures preserve the response body as diagnostic evidence
